$comment: The engine_params version this repository believes production is running.
It lives in JSON, alone, because two very different readers need it: the
plain-ESM drift script (scripts/check-migrations.mjs), which cannot import
TypeScript. One declaration, no duplication, no build step.
Activations happen outside the repo — propose_engine_params →
replay_decisions → activate_engine_params, run from an MCP client, with no
PR and no commit in the loop. So nothing here updates itself. After
activating a version: add its V<n>_PARAMS rung to the ladder, update the
two fields below, and run `npm run db:check`.
hash is the stored params_hash — sha256 over the canonical sorted-key JSON
of the row — which live-params.test.ts recomputes from the fixture. That
makes a hand-written rung provably the row rather than approximately it.
N87 exists because the old V26 fixture was only approximately right.
note: v27 — deload target_rir 6→8 and e1rm.max_measuring_rir 8→5, so deload work sits above the measuring cutoff and cannot enter a strength anchor.
